scripts.dev:server: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter server run dev
scripts.start:server: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter server run start
scripts.start:web: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter web run start
scripts.dev:web: dotenv run -- node scripts/use-server.ts "[web] pnpm --filter web run dev"
scripts.dev:cli: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter cli run dev
scripts.dev:app: dotenv run -- node scripts/use-server.ts "[app] pnpm --filter app run tauri dev"
scripts.dev:app:ios: dotenv run -- node scripts/use-server.ts --host "[app] pnpm --filter app run tauri ios dev --host"
scripts.dev:app:android: dotenv run -- node scripts/use-server.ts --host "[app] pnpm --filter app run tauri android dev --host"
scripts.open:app:ios: dotenv run -- node scripts/use-server.ts --host "[app] pnpm --filter app run tauri ios dev --host --open"
scripts.open:app:android: dotenv run -- node scripts/use-server.ts --host "[app] pnpm --filter app run tauri android dev --host --open"
scripts.build:app: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter app run tauri build
scripts.build:app:ios:ci: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter app run build:ios:ci
scripts.build:app:ios: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter app run tauri ios build
scripts.build:app:android: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter app run tauri android build
scripts.build:gui: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter gui run build
scripts.build:cli: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter cli run build
scripts.install:cli: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter cli build && cp apps/cli/dist/tiny-chat ~/.local/bin/tiny-chat
